note: Questions no single article answers. The gold set is deliberately two or three PRIMARY articles that live in different chapters, so recall@10 — not MRR — is the metric that matters. This is the shape a note de synthèse actually needs (docs/PLAN.md §1, slice 2).

cases.query: un salarié licencié pour faute grave après douze ans d'ancienneté a-t-il droit au préavis et à l'indemnité de licenciement
cases.note: Two independent rules, both expressed as an exception to faute grave and located in two different sections. Answering with either one alone produces a confidently half-wrong memo.

cases.query: calculer l'indemnité de licenciement d'un salarié ayant douze ans d'ancienneté et quel salaire de référence retenir
cases.note: Rate (R1234-2) and base (R1234-4) are two separate articles, and the second is the one clients dispute. Also a numeric-content case: R1234-2 is almost entirely fractions.

cases.query: requalification d'un CDD en CDI quel texte l'impose et devant quelle formation l'affaire est portée
cases.note: Substantive rule plus procedural route, two adjacent articles that share no vocabulary with each other. Both primary; either alone is unusable.

cases.query: licenciement nul pour harcèlement moral quelles sont les conséquences indemnitaires et le remboursement des allocations chômage
cases.note: A three-hop across three different books: nullity (L1152-3), the indemnity floor for a nullity (L1235-3-1) and the Pôle emploi refund (L1235-4). The hardest case in the set.

cases.query: inaptitude d'origine non professionnelle reclassement impossible reprise du versement du salaire au bout d'un mois
cases.note: The one-month salary-resumption rule (L1226-4) is what makes the employer move, and it is in a different article from the dismissal condition. Two primaries, adjacent but distinct.

cases.query: contester un licenciement économique : dans quel délai agir et quelle formation saisir en premier
cases.note: Deadline and forum, from two different parts of the Code, asked in one sentence the way a client asks it. Tests whether the top 10 can hold two unrelated legal topics at once.

cases.query: salarié discriminé puis licencié : nullité de la rupture et sanction financière de l'employeur
cases.note: The prohibition and the nullity are two articles apart; the refund obligation is in a third book and cites both. A forward-citation chain that pure similarity cannot follow.
